versions.changelog:
Initial release of Multi-Source Data Cleanser:

- Cleans and deduplicates messy data from Excel, CSV, JSON, and clipboard text.
- AI-powered auto-detection for common fields (name, phone, email, address, etc.) with user override.
- Supports smart fill for missing data, format standardization, and fuzzy matching (Pro).
- Merges and joins data from multiple sources with conflict resolution (Pro).
- Exports to Excel/CSV, writes to Feishu Bitable, and generates quality reports (Pro).
- Tiered feature set with free, Basic, Standard, and Pro plans.
